csv_project_name: Engineer for West Lake Dr Estelle River Bridge Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Fort Lauderdale may be seeking Engineering service for replacement of the West Lake Drive Bridge (#865771), spanning over the Estelle River. The main bridge material is primarily reinforced concrete. The bridge is approximately 140-feet long by 30-feet wide, with a narrow 2.4-foot sidewalk on one side. The two-lane bridge serves as the only access to the island and is a designated school bus route. There are no pile driving records for this bridge, and the foundation is unknown at this time.
